text: He who would read this chapter well must attend to what is left out of it. Sarah appears nowhere in it; and in the very next verse we are told that she died. Nothing is said directly, yet the scene implies that something in the household did not survive the mountain. At precisely the point where a weaker storyteller would have lingered, the narrator turns away, and what he withholds carries its own meaning, as much as anything he sets down. Abraham returns to the servants; of Isaac there is not a word.
